notes: Both qal and pual are attested only as the passive/adjectival participle ("foursquare", of architectural features in Exodus/1Kings/Ezekiel) -- no finite forms of either stem occur in the corpus. Both included as attested; gloss "squared" fits every citation checked.

Retroactively renamed from the plain key "רבע" to "רבע²" when H7250 ("mate; breed") was added to the dataset as "רבע¹" -- true homograph (same spelling and pointing), per the root-key superscript convention (lower Strong's number gets ¹).
